project_overview.purpose: Smoke test the DBOS pipeline skeleton end-to-end

key_user_flows: Submit spec -> pipeline runs -> consolidated output returned

non_functional_requirements.performance: Full pipeline under 5 minutes on CPU-only hardware
non_functional_requirements.availability: Local dev tool, no uptime SLA
non_functional_requirements.security: All data stays on-device, no cloud egress

technical_constraints.budget_infra_limits: No cloud spend, fully local execution

data_architecture.data_flow: Spec -> Researcher -> Architect -> Scribe -> Critic -> Judge -> human review
data_architecture.retention_compliance: No PII, internal technical content only, retained indefinitely
